title: Rank-one condensed resolution of the actual uniformizer quotient
statement: For a prime l, a finite intermediate extension E of Q_l in its algebraic closure, pi generating the maximal ideal of the integer ring O_E, and n natural, there exists a short exact sequence of condensed O_E modules at the profinite point whose first two terms are isomorphic to the regular O_E module and whose third is isomorphic to the regular completedResidue l E pi n module restricted along the actual quotientMap l E pi n. Here the arithmetic coefficient objects and actual quotient map are those of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams], and PointModules is the internal point-module category of [def-sfb-integral-finite-scalar-model-interfaces].

proof.text: The maximal ideal of O_E is nonzero, so its generator pi and its positive power r are nonzero. Form the pointwise condensed module maps multiplication by r and actual quotient reduction; the monoid-hom law makes reduction linear.

The quotient ideal is open: the inverse image of the field ball of radius norm(r) around zero lies in (r). Every element in this ball divides by r inside O_E. Thus the quotient topology is discrete. A set-theoretic section of its surjective quotient map is continuous and lifts every continuous profinite section.

Injectivity of multiplication is pointwise cancellation. A continuous section in the kernel of reduction divides continuously by r in the ambient field; membership in the principal ideal ensures the quotient remains in O_E. Therefore the sequence is sectionwise short exact. Reflect this through the faithful forgetful functor to internal module objects. The first two terms and the quotient have the stated regular-module identifications.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalUniformizer_pointResolution
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ P : ShortComplex (IntegralFiniteScalar.PointModules
        (CommMon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1))),
      P.ShortExact ∧
      Nonempty (P.X₁ ≅ Mod.regular (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1)) ∧
      Nonempty (P.X₂ ≅ Mod.regular (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.{u} l E.1)) ∧
      Nonempty (P.X₃ ≅ (Mod.comap (quotientMap l E π n)).obj
        (Mod.regular (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))))
